correctness.rationale: For Q3, an acyclic gradient pairing is precisely a directed rooted forest with outdegree at most one. Independent 4^8 tail-state enumeration gives the entire face vector (24,240,1296,4080,7488,7424,3072). Reconstructed 24-arc ordered greedy matching yields exactly 11695 pairs and 50 critical dimension-5 and 185 critical dimension-6 faces. A full 23625-node, 124200-incidence directed Hasse topological sort verifies acyclicity, not a sample. Independently rebuilt signed integer discrete-Morse matrix is 50x185 with 366 entries ±1; exact rational rank 46 and integer Smith factors all one (46). This leaves H5=Z^4 and H6=Z^139 with no torsion. Because cells occur only in degrees 0,5,6, their attaching maps are integer-degree maps into a wedge of 5-spheres and unit Smith transformations cancel 46 pairs, proving the advertised sphere-wedge homotopy equivalence. Empty-face release and no extraneous dimension are checked. Finite exhaustive proof applies only to Q3.
residual_risks: Proof depends on full exhaustive finite computation and exact signed cancellation; no higher-Qn statement.
A historical Cayley-directed-forest thesis remains inaccessible for originality, not a proof defect.
